about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Technology is my craft. Architecture is my passion.
about.desc_intro:
I have been active in the Java ecosystem as a freelance developer since the very beginning of Java (JDK 1.0.2). Starting with classic J2EE and full-stack projects, I have specialized over the years in complex backend architectures, middleware, and modern cloud technologies.
Today, my focus is on the design and implementation of demanding enterprise backends, hexagonal architectures, and modern cloud solutions, complemented by the daily use of AI tools to increase efficiency.
about.story_text:
The journey began in 1998 with JDK 1.0.2. In the early years, my focus was on developing web frontends and portals (JSP, Servlets, Swing). With the rise of Spring and Hibernate, my focus shifted increasingly to backend development and the architecture of enterprise applications.
I work with a hands-on mentality and lived craftsmanship: I don't just write code, I maintain it. Clean Code, TDD, and a clean architecture are the foundation for maintainable and future-proof systems.
In recent years, I have worked on cloud migrations (AWS, Azure), microservices, and hexagonal architecture. Today, I combine these classic enterprise virtues with modern technologies such as Kubernetes. I am currently expanding my profile in the area of AI integration (LLMs) in the Java environment and already actively use AI tools in my daily development work.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions I get asked most often.
faq.q1: Which technologies and architectures do you use?
faq.a1: I primarily work agile AI-powered with Java 17/21/25, Spring Boot 3/4, hexagonal architecture, and TDD. In the cloud environment, I use AWS, Azure, Docker, and Kubernetes
faq.q2: How does a project with you work?
faq.a2: We discuss how I can support you with my expertise in achieving your goals and fit in with your team both humanely and characteristically. The implementation is done agilely (Scrum/Kanban) with regular reviews. I work remotely/hybrid or on-site in Berlin and the surrounding area (25km).
faq.q3: Are you available for new projects?
faq.a3_partial_available: Yes, I am partially available for new projects.

hero.desc:
As a Senior Java Backend Developer, my focus is on developing robust and scalable systems. With over **25 years of experience**, I support companies in modernizing their enterprise applications and moving them to the cloud. Not as a theorist, but with a hands-on mentality and craftsmanship approach, I step in where it matters most – and continuously evolve alongside technological challenges.
I bring my architectural knowledge to your projects to build sustainable solutions together with you and your team. Whether it's cloud migration, AI integration, or modernizing legacy systems: I contribute as an experienced developer who doesn't just write code, but also takes responsibility for the big picture and approaches new technologies with curiosity.
Currently, I am particularly driven by the topics of architecture, AI, and DLT.
